subject.text: My laptop keeps asking to restart, is it a virus?

description.text: Since yesterday a message keeps appearing: 'Update ready to install. Restart to finish.'
It pops up again every hour and I always click 'Later'.
I'm afraid to restart because many presentation files are still open.
Other than that the laptop is fine, not slow and no errors.

history.text: Monday: the IT team pushed an official security update to all office laptops.

explanation: That message comes from an official update that only needs a restart, not a virus and not a fault. Guide Bayu to save all his files first, then restart so the update can finish installing.
hints: Read the message carefully. Who sent that update?
An official update that is ready only needs a restart. What should Bayu do before restarting?
